user_query: My company is organizing a team-building event and we need to order customized t-shirts for all the employees. Can you search for t-shirt printing services on Zappos? Include options that offer bulk orders, provide the product details and customer reviews for each service. Additionally, find some customer reviews for the t-shirt printing services on Amazon to ensure their reliability.

TaskList.description: Search for t-shirt printing services on Zappos that offer bulk orders.
Retrieve product details and customer reviews for each t-shirt printing service found on Zappos.
Search for customer reviews of t-shirt printing services on Amazon.
Compile and compare the reviews from Amazon with the reviews from Zappos to ensure reliability.
